text.title: Graceful Offboard Script Worked Examples
text.summary: One complete offboard artefact for a retail client whose margin sat at 11% against a 30% target for three quarters, with the script text the artefact describes and a note on every non-obvious value, and one bad artefact showing what the validator and the reviewer reject.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: Northwind Retail has been on a growth-marketing retainer for 18 months. The Q2 2026 QBR shows gross margin on the account at 11% against a 30% target for the third consecutive quarter and 14 out-of-scope requests in the quarter against a contractual cap of 4. Northwind's own roadmap is moving toward in-store systems integration, which the agency does not do. The MSA (clause 14.2) allows termination on 30 days' notice; July is prepaid.

example.title: Northwind offboard, last service date 2026-07-10
example.note: Two signals, both with value, target and period; the margin one spans three quarters, so it is a pattern, not a bad quarter (r-bad-fit-evidenced-by-qbr-data).

`last_service_date` is 35 days after the decision on a 30-day clause, and the prepaid July is delivered in full rather than refunded, so no invoice is disputed (r-exit-date-honours-termination-clause).
Six assets, every one client-owned and transferred on a date before the last service date, none conditioned on payment; 30 days of included transition support (r-handover-plan-with-asset-inventory).
Bridgeport was confirmed by call on 2026-06-02, three days before the client heard the name (r-recommended-alternative-confirmed-first).
Video call and written follow-up on the same day; the written version carries the handover plan and nothing the call did not (r-delivered-live-then-written).
Feedback is scheduled for 2026-08-09, exactly 30 days after the last service date, with both response paths decided in advance (r-post-offboard-feedback-at-t-plus-30).
Root cause is scope and expectations (the 14 requests), and the intake change is concrete: two new qualification questions. Nothing to flag (r-root-cause-changes-intake-criteria).

example.title: The written follow-up the artefact describes
example.code:
Subject: Our conversation today — next steps and handover plan
Tom,
Thank you for the time today. As discussed: your roadmap has moved toward in-store systems integration; we are built for e-commerce growth work, and you will get more from a partner whose core is integration. Our last service date is 10 July 2026, in line with clause 14.2 of the MSA, and July is delivered in full as prepaid.
Handover (attached in full): Google Ads and GA4 admin transfer on 3 July, DNS on 6 July, the storefront repository and Figma files on 8 July, runbooks and documentation on 9 July. We remain available for questions for 30 days after 10 July at no charge.
Bridgeport Systems do ERP and POS integration for retailers of your size and have confirmed they would welcome an introduction; say the word and I will connect you this week.
We will check in with you in early August to hear how the transition has gone.
Maria
example.note: Every sentence about Northwind is neutral or positive; the fit statement, the date, the clause, the prepaid disposition, the per-asset schedule, the support window and the confirmed introduction are all in the text, and nothing that was not said on the call.

example.title: What the validator and the reviewer reject
example.note: Validator output: `$.bad_fit_signals: 1 items, minItems=2`, `$.bad_fit_signals[0].consecutive_quarters: 1 violates minimum=2`, `$.contract.prepaid_period.disposition: 'not_applicable' not in enum ['delivered_in_full', 'refunded']`, `$.script.framing: must equal 'fit_and_alignment', got 'apology'`, `$.script.states_last_service_date: must equal True, got False`, `$.script.banned_phrases_found: 2 items, maxItems=0`, `$.script.client_criticism_found: must equal False, got True`, `$.handover.assets[0].conditioning_clause_id: missing required field`, `$.handover.transition_support.days: 0 violates minimum=1`, `$.handover.transition_support.rate: missing required field`, `$.alternatives: 0 items, minItems=1`, `$.delivery.written_follow_up.business_days_after_conversation: 5 violates maximum=1`, `$.delivery.written_follow_up.contains_only_what_was_said: must equal True, got False`, `$.delivery.written_follow_up.includes_handover_plan: must equal True, got False`, `$.delivery.email_only: must equal False, got True`, `$.feedback_request.days_after_last_service: must equal 30, got 0`, `$.feedback_request.non_promoter_action: must equal 'thank_and_ask_one_question_no_argument', got 'explain_why_they_are_wrong'`, `$.internal_record.reviewer: missing required field`, `$.internal_record.flagged_for_review: must equal True, got False`.

What the reviewer sees beyond the validator: 14 days' notice against a 30-day clause is a breach the client can invoice for (r-exit-date-honours-termination-clause); a single ad account in the inventory when the agency also holds DNS, GA4, the repository and the design files means the rest will be chased for after the exit (r-handover-plan-with-asset-inventory).
